name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Ever since the family-run Scandinavian company started in 1971 and for nearly 50 years of experience on the market, Cedarbrook Sauna and Steam provided its customers with great service and a fine product that withstands double inspection with each Infrared sauna unit. The lumber used in the manufacture is of high quality, service before and after purchase is informative and helpful, the design is thought through and will provide comfort and safety of use.



Near Infrared therapy has proven over the years that the penetrating heat is similar to that of the sun’s heat and brings many benefits in health and quality of life. Among those benefits are removing toxins and harmful substances (medicinal and other) from the body, helps clear cellulite, skin purification and beautification, stress removal, promoting better sleep and deep relaxation, pain relief from arthritis and muscle aches as well as soothing joint stiffness and help with sprains, weight control, burning calories, strengthening cardiovascular system and improving heart rate and stabilizing blood pressure.
